description: AstroCS BLD-001 frozen toolchain contract (09_WINDOWS_TOOLCHAIN_LOCK.md). Single source of truth read by cmake/toolchain/verify_toolchain.py. The formal Windows surface (CMakePresets.json windows presets + packaging/windows/.vsconfig) must match every field below exactly; drift fails fast with a non-zero exit. This file is NOT a CMake presets schema: CMakePresets.json is validated by CMake itself (schema version 10) at parse/configure time.

linux_light.role: light validation only; NOT a release artifact and NOT a Windows driver
linux_light.generator_policy: never overrides the Windows formal generator; never hardcodes a forbidden generator on the Linux control node
